description: Raw note co-occurrence counts from the existing note wheel; no lift weighting or clustering applied.

schema.names: Row and column labels, in matrix order.
schema.matrix: matrix[i][j] counts source perfumes listing both names[i] and names[j], across all note tiers. Symmetric. Diagonal is zero by visualization convention, not note frequency.
schema.totals: Number of source perfumes listing each note; use this instead of the matrix diagonal.
schema.groups: Existing assigned scent families, NOT communities discovered from the matrix.
schema.aliases: Known spelling/label variants retained as distinct nodes in the source. Consider merging from record-level data before network analysis; do not simply sum counts because perfumes may contain both labels.

populationNote: The aggregate wheel covers 24,059 source perfumes; the separate profile catalog contains 24,050. This matrix was not recalculated from the sample profiles.
